inputs.text: If the response includes a |Sec-WebSocket-Protocol| header field and this header field indicates the use of a subprotocol that was not present in the client's handshake (the server has indicated a subprotocol not requested by the client), the client MUST _Fail the WebSocket Connection_.

response.quote: If the response includes a |Sec-WebSocket-Protocol| header field and this header field indicates the use of a subprotocol that was not present in the client's handshake (the server has indicated a subprotocol not requested by the client), the client MUST _Fail the WebSocket Connection_.

status.unsupported: The model does not implement logic to check for mismatched subprotocols in the server's response or fail the connection accordingly.
